response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but his profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role. His C++ experience is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He has no Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a retail investment fintech, not capital markets), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth. His recent decade centers on TypeScript/Node.js, D, and full-stack web work.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience with strong fundamentals (TDD, CI/CD, low-latency systems)
Proven low-latency/high-throughput systems work (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and teaching experience
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and over a decade old, versus the mandatory 5–10 years on Windows
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; stack is MongoDB/MySQL-oriented

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering seniority and CI/CD skills
